Tenancy: Ask agent Let type: Long term Furnish type: Furnished Council Tax: Ask agent PROPERTY TYPE Apartment BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE 900 sq ft 84 sq m 1 +30 Key features 2 Double Bedroom Apartment with Built-in Wardrobe (2nd Floor with Lift)Double Reception Room with Dining Area & Floor to Ceiling Large WindowsFully Fitted Kitchen Integrated with Well-Known Appliances2 x Luxurious Bathroom (1 x En-Suite) with Dark Chrome Fixtures & FittingsInternal Area: 900 Sq Ft / EPC-B / Water Garden View / Utility RoomBespoke Furnishings / Balcony-Terrace (140.0 Sq Ft Additionally) / Storage RoomAir Ventilation / Underfloor Heating / Air Conditioning / Double Glazed WindowsResidents' Swimming Pool, Gym, Meeting Room, Resident's Lounge & Cineplex24 Hr Concierge / 24 Hr Security / Communal Gardens / Bars / Restaurants Description *** White City Living W12 - Flagship Building - Cassini Apartments *** This very stylish 2 double bedroom apartment sets in White City Living situated within the heart of Shepherds Bush. The property enjoys easy access to a number of transport stations, with Wood Lane, White City & Shepherds Bush Underground, Overground & Train Stations being close by (Central, Circle, District, Hammersmith & City Lines, Overground & Southern Trains). There are also plenty of local buses available along the area. Sets on the 2nd floor spanning just under 900 Sq Ft internally, this impeccable apartment is offered on a furnished basis. It comprises a large open-plan double reception room with dining space and sizeable floor-to-ceiling windows affording lots of natural daylight into the property. There's a spacious fully fitted modern kitchen built-in with well-known appliances and a built-in breakfast island, good size master double bedroom with a large built-in wardrobe, luxurious stone finish en-suite double walk-in shower room, 2nd double bedroom with 2nd built-in wardrobe, further family bathroom with ample storages in the hallway, an internal storage room, utility room and an exceptional private balcony-terrace (140 Sq Ft additionally) accessible from the all principal rooms. The property further benefits include air conditioning, underfloor heating, air ventilation system, iDevice controllable home automation system, double-glazed windows, hardwood floors in the reception room, luxury comfort carpet in the bedroom, storage room and a good size utility room. The residents also freely enjoy from 24 hours security, concierge, CCTV, lift access, resident's lounge, meeting room, reading area, beautiful swimming pool, spa, top-end fully-equipped onsite gym facility, communal gardens and high-spec cineplex (personal Blu-ray disc on demand & PS4 Pro available). The property is ideally located close to the open spaces of Holland Park & Shepherds Bush Green; ideal for outdoor pursuits. Westfield shopping centre is within walking distance and offers a range of amenities that includes a cinema, designer shops, eateries and children's play activities. Other nearby amenities include a selection of theatres, lively bars, nightclubs, restaurants and cafes.
